1.uninvitation:
I know you've been busy, preparing for this anniversary...
But I sure didn't expect you to personally hand me an invitation.
I'm ready to accept it whenever you're ready to give it.
1.getgift:
What a beautiful brooch. And the motif... Is this an eagle?
It's got a very soft feeling to it, despite the heroic imagery.
Thanks, Commander. I'll treasure it.
1.getletter:
Thanks for inviting me to the banquet.
Only problem is, there's not much time left to prepare...
So, I'd better hurry and do that. We'll meet at the venue later.
feeling: Come enjoy the banquet with me, Commander.
Hey, Commander... What do you think about my dress?
1.ungift:
Things sure are lively at this banquet, Commander.
It feels like ages ago when you and I had a private moment...
Hm? What's this? A present, for me?
drinkfeeling: What do you say to a drink, Commander?
Don't drink too much, now. It'd be bad if you got drunk.
foodfeeling: They really cooked up a whole feast, huh? Found any favorites, Commander?
This taste is gonna stick with me. I'm curious how the chefs made it.
dancefeeling: You wanna dance? Sure. Just give me orders... I mean, instructions, on what to do.
I need to work on my dancing skills.

2.uninvitation:
Do you have a mission for me, Commander?
I'll set out at once if you need me to! ...That's not it?
Well, if it's not a mission, then what?
2.getgift:
Oh! You actually got me the bike model I've wanted for ages!
Are you a mind reader or something? Because wow...
Thank you so, so much! Do you mind if I open it right away?
2.getletter:
An invitation...? Oh, of course – the anniversary is tonight!
I assume you'll be attending the banquet, Commander?
That's great! Now I'm feeling excited about this!
feeling: Oh my god, you're looking sooo stylish, Commander! I wanna check you out up close...
Found you, Commandeeer! Hehehe... No, I'm not drunk at aaall~
2.ungift:
What's the matter, Commander? Is there something on my clothes?
Oh! No way... I've wanted one of these for so long!
Just kidding. There's no way you'd get me exactly what I wanted, right?
drinkfeeling: What a lovely fragrance! Commander, you should taste this. I really recommend it.
Oh, don't be ridiculous! I won't get drunk this time! Probably...
foodfeeling: It all looks so delicious... Where do I even start?
What's your favorite thing on the menu, Commander?
dancefeeling: A dance? You sound pretty confident in yourself~
One step to the right, one to the left... Okay, I still remember it.

3.uninvitation:
You coming to me in person... How unusual.
Before we get down to your important business, let's sit down and rest.
I have tea, if you want some. Just relax, get comfortable, and tell me what you have to say.
3.getgift:
Ah, a music box. What intricate craftsmanship, and what sublime sound...
I should expect no less from someone of your taste.
I will treasure it. Now, how should I repay your kindness... Heehee.
3.getletter:
I accept your invitation.
Getting dressed and the like can come later...
More immediately, won't you sit down and enjoy some tea with me?
feeling: I heard your work has been rough on you... You should unwind for a while.
This will be a riveting banquet as long as you're here. Heehee.
3.ungift:
What is it? You seem a bit absent-minded.
You didn't call for me just for nothing, did you?
Go on, speak your desire. You've no reason to hesitate with me.
drinkfeeling: Heehee. You may drink all you like tonight, Commander.
Had too much, and now your head is spinning? Heehee. Don't worry, I'll look after you.
foodfeeling: It's quite the departure from Sakuran cuisine, but not at all in a bad way.
Open your mouth and say "aah." What, are you too shy to try? Heehee.
dancefeeling: If it's a dance you want, I suggest we do a slow one.
There is no avoiding physical contact when it comes to dancing.

4.uninvitation:
Don't tell me that's an invitation ya got there.
You didn't need to bother with one. I'd hang out with you anyway.
Although... I do appreciate the thought...
4.getgift:
A compass? That sure brings back fond memories.
Thanks. I like it a lot.
Now I've gotta think of something to repay you... Hmm...
4.getletter:
Appreciate the invitation. Now just to prepare for the banquet...
Gonna be hard deciding what to wear.
Anyway, I'll see you at the venue.
feeling: Been lookin' for you, Commander. Whaddya say we catch a break and go on a walk together?
I'll be here with ya the whole day. Lemme know if you want something.
4.ungift:
I've not done anything to deserve a present.
All I hope is you're enjoyin' the party, that's all...
You picked it out just for me? Man...
drinkfeeling: Our drinks are hand-picked. They won't disappoint.
To our... Erp... To our friends. Cheers.
foodfeeling: Alright, sit down and have your fill of the good stuff our chefs made.
Our chefs put their all into this. Hope ya like it.
dancefeeling: A dance, eh... I'm not one to turn down an offer from you.
Just lettin' you know – I ain't the best dancer. Might step on your toes by accident...

5.uninvitation:
Good to see you, Commander.
Why don't we get comfortable and enjoy some drinks?
What's that in your hand? May I have a look?
5.getgift:
Ooh! What a cute little bear!
Thank you. I will cherish this little cutie... *pat pat*
What? No, I'm not drunk at all!
5.getletter:
So it's an invitation for me. Thank you kindly.
You'll be in attendance at the banquet too, won't you?
Heehee. I'm already looking forward to seeing you dance.
feeling: Heehee. It's such a pleasure to see you, Commander.
Commander, shall we do something to really liven up this banquet?
5.ungift:
Whew... You make this banquet so enjoyable, Commander.
Hmm? What are you looking for?
Is this a present for me? Heehee. I'm curious to see what's inside.
drinkfeeling: Mmh~ This has a wonderful fragrance.
foodfeeling: These dishes all look stunning. They're works of art in their own right!
dancefeeling: I'm honored that you'd like to dance. Shall we?
You can come closer if you'd like, Commander. This IS a dance.

6.uninvitation:
Well. You're looking stylish tonight, servant.
If you have business with me, tell it to one of my maids and...
It has to be me, you say? What could be so important you must speak to me directly?
6.getgift:
A crystal wand... This is a surprise, coming from you.
To be truthful, I have enough wands to warrant their own storage room...
But, this one I'll put up somewhere everyone can see it.
6.getletter:
A banquet invitation... Very well.
Bel, tell the Royal Maids to begin the preparations.
Hold it right there, servant! I never gave you permission to leave my side!
feeling: Servant! Come here, quickly! We're going to have a look around the banquet!
You've really put your all into this, servant. Hmpf! Yes, even I acknowledge hard work from time to time!
6.ungift:
Trying to be stealthy? You have a present for me, don't you?
I know the tells of a gift-giver because I receive plenty of presents every single day!
Admittedly... I'm more excited than usual to receive one from you. Slightly.
drinkfeeling: I can tell these wine brands are both carefully chosen and well-aged.
This toast is for you, servant... Wh-what? You look surprised to hear that...
foodfeeling: This food isn't so bad. I'll give it a thumbs up.
Servant, come here and enjoy the cooking with me.
dancefeeling: Well, well. Let's see how much you've improved.
Servant! Try to keep up with my steps!

7.uninvitation:
I appreciate you coming to see me.
Still have many places to be, do you? That must be tiring.
I'm up to my neck with work as well, so I suppose that makes both of us busy bees for the day...
7.getgift:
A vinyl record? Did you choose the songs?
Why, I'll be... These are all my favorite songs.
I will think of you whenever I play them. Heehee.
7.getletter:
Of course. I promise I'll be at the banquet.
I've had too much on my mind lately, and I need to sort my thoughts out.
We'll meet again at the venue, Commander.
feeling: I'm forever in your debt. Allow me to thank you again for all you do.
I'm having a wonderful time here, thanks to you, Commander.
7.ungift:
I thank you for showing me how to enjoy this banquet, Commander.
Preparing a present for me, though, is really going above and beyond.
What a perfect end to a wonderful day. Heehee.
drinkfeeling: Drinking alone isn't bad, but it's much more enjoyable to drink with you.
Whew... I think I've had too much... Could I lean on your shoulder for a minute?
foodfeeling: It's rare that I get to just enjoy food worrying about appearances.
It enhances the eating experience so much when you have company.
dancefeeling: You're asking me to dance? Heehee. Then I leave myself in your capable hands.
I was like a different person when we danced, you say? Heehee.
